budget_note: Seven first-pass fixed-head batches are a coverage proposal, not seven retries or spending authorization. Each needs exact free-token-count/request-envelope validation before an authorized paid run. No paid call, activation or review has occurred in preparing this manifest. $21 is the planning ceiling at seven times $3, not permission to spend it. Retries and follow-up rounds need explicit, bounded session intent and preserved append-only claims.
eligibility_blockers: Production credential isolation/setup and trusted trigger behavior remain unverified; PR #7049 must not be activated.
Current production reviewer rejects draft PRs and >200-file full comparisons; direct commands cannot review this 269-file draft.
No trusted immutable manifest/batch runner currently exists. Do not mark R4 ready or raise the global file/input cap merely to bypass eligibility.
Seven batches exceed the fixed normal two/head and three/PR payment caps. No scoped grant or trusted batch runner is implemented; ordinary commands cannot authorize or run this plan.
gates_before_paid_review: Administrator rotated environment-only credentials, protected sprint-only environment, secret exposure cleanup and durable ledger/spending controls independently verified.
User approves any future deployment/switch required for activation. This request does not authorize merge, release or disabling Copilot.
After activation, separately review a minimal trusted fixed-source batch/session path retaining tool-free execution, pinned actions, exact immutable source and no PR code execution.

Before first payment, verify live R4 head/base still equal this manifest; recompute patch hashes, source blob SHAs and disjoint exhaustive membership. Invalidate/regenerate this manifest for any changed head/base.
Freeze one authorized seven-batch first-pass session with explicit cumulative spend ceiling, unique per-batch claims and no automatic paid retries. Keep Copilot enabled.
Review complete exact patches and targeted immutable cross-batch context within each envelope; report source omissions without claiming full-source inspection.
Record each batch as complete/incomplete/stale with head/base/manifest/batch identity, model, token usage, reservation/cost and finding dispositions.

Resolve significant findings in source, then run appropriate Cloud regressions and independent focused re-review of changed source before another local-validation attempt. Changed code produces a new SHA and requires refreshed exact-head coverage/handoff.

context_plan.cross_batch_note: Backup/account and wallet/faucet ownership must be checked together using captured immutable context; vault signer, channel and store interactions likewise require explicit context or an independent integration follow-up. Context sizes above are not paid prompt measurements; exact JSON-encoded bytes and token count must be rechecked.

native_validation.summary: Current local attempt failed to produce/install either app after disk/dependency interruptions; no native scenarios or physical signer checks passed. Docker/service and phone/signer availability remain blocked. Do not attempt native validation again before significant independent review findings are resolved.

provenance.file_inventory: GitHub pull/7045 files pages 1..3, 100 per page; head/base/draft rechecked unchanged after inventory; immutable tree SHA/modes/blob SHAs validated.
provenance.measurement: UTF-8 raw patch bytes and Python json.dumps(ensure_ascii=True) compatible formatting of production collect() diff records, including context_unavailable placeholders, plus the candidate SYSTEM. Batch/session metadata and optional source will add bytes; each proposal remains below 300KB before those additions.
provenance.patch_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of exact GitHub API patch string encoded as UTF-8, without an added trailing newline.
provenance.inventory_layout: Each batch files_manifest is relative to this plan and bound by SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 file bytes. Verify all seven artifacts and their shared immutable snapshot before use. Split inventories avoid GitHub omitting oversized individual patches.
